data.name: Dervish Dance
data.description: You have learned to turn your speed into power, even with a heavier blade. Use Dex modifier instead of Str modifier with scimitar. You have learned to turn your speed into power, even with a heavier blade. When wielding a scimitar with one hand, you can use your Dexterity modifier intead of your Strength modifier on melee attack and damage rolls. You treat the scimitar as a one-handed piercing weapon for all feats and class abilities that require such a weapon. The scimitar must be for a creature of your size. You cannot use this feat if you are carrying a weapon or shield in your off hand.
